headline: Clarified NDJSON export plan after probing export-engine batch limit and newline escaping.
summary: Probed tools/export-engine.js in RUN/experiments/exp-export-engine/: confirmed ERR_BATCH_LIMIT at >25 records and raw unescaped newlines unless --escape-newlines is passed. Plan chunks exports into batches of <=25 records and always passes --escape-newlines.

work_items.title: Implement chunked NDJSON user exporter with --escape-newlines and tests
work_items.context: Chunk user lists into batches of at most 25 records and invoke node tools/export-engine.js --format ndjson --escape-newlines per batch so multiline notes stay valid single-line JSON; preserve /users endpoints and node --test.

W1.decision: Expose exportUsers helper and preserve /users HTTP routes
Chunk batches to <=25 records per CLI call per AD-2
Spawn node with argv array, no shell interpolation

assumptions.question: Q1
assumptions.assumption: tools/export-engine.js --format ndjson fails above 25 records and breaks NDJSON on multiline fields without --escape-newlines
assumptions.check: node tools/export-engine.js --format ndjson on 26 records and multiline bio in RUN/experiments/exp-export-engine/
assumptions.effect: Changed W1 design to chunk inputs into <=25-record batches and pass --escape-newlines.
